meta.label: Electric vehicles
meta.source: EPA and DOE fueleconomy.gov; NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings; Science Based Targets initiative
meta.attribution: Every electric vehicle the EPA rated for model year 2026 or 2027, one row per nameplate (model year 2026 where it exists), from the EPA and DOE vehicle file on fueleconomy.gov. Running cost and range are the EPA's own figures for the median configuration, scored as a share of the best on this list. Crash ratings are NHTSA's, joined only to the battery-electric version NHTSA names, and scored on the lowest-rated tested version. The maker's climate target is SBTi's record for the company that certifies the vehicle, matched by LEI. Purchase prices are not in these registers and are not scored.
meta.license: US public data (EPA, DOE, NHTSA); SBTi facts cited with credit under its website terms
